Name: Rice Paddy Pond
Author: metalax
Description:
Uses TMXLoader to edit the small pond on the default Farm map to be more suitable for use as a rice paddy. Only the tiles in the 10x12 area of the pond are altered, so it should be compatible with any mods that alter other areas of the map.

If you wish to add this to an existing save, make sure you have cleared the area around the pond first or you will be left with objects stuck floating on the pond.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXLoader[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][TMX] RicePaddyPond[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac and on previous versions supported by TMXLoader.
[*] Compatible with SMAPI 3.0.0 (untested on earlier versions, but it might still work).
[*] Should be no mod conflicts aside from those that edit the tiles of the pond(let me know if you find one).
[*] Should be fine with any language version.
[/list]

[size=4]Variants[/size]
A version that shifts the pond one tile up and one tile right is available under optional files in the files tab. Follow the instructions the the description if updating in an existing game.
Shoot me a PM if you are looking for a variant with similar small chages.
